qualifier: RB-E2F repression and cyclin-CDK control at both G1/S and G2/M
name: G1/S and G2/M checkpoint control via RB-E2F and cyclin-CDKs
rationale: Members cover cell cycle transition control at G1/S (RB1/E2F, cyclin D/E-CDK, p27/p21 degradation) and G2/M (Chk1/2, cyclin B, PLK, p53 G2 arrest); C1/C4 are E2F/G1/S-transcription focused and C2/C3 are p53/DNA-damage focused, while this theme alone spans RB-E2F and cyclin-CDK control of both transitions.

name: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis and inhibitory immunoreceptor regulation
rationale: Members concern IgG Fc receptor activation, ADCC and phagocytic cup formation together with inhibitory receptors (CD22, SIRP, Fc inhibitory signaling, negative B cell/neutrophil regulation); C1 adds Fc-epsilon/mast cell and BCR activation, C3 generic myeloid inflammation, and C2/C4 hypersensitivity without the phagocytic and inhibitory members.

qualifier: proximal-distal patterning and distal tubule segments
name: Nephron patterning and distal tubule segment development
rationale: All members describe nephron formation from renal vesicle through comma/S-shaped bodies to tubule segments; unlike confusables (nephric duct, ureteric bud, MET), the theme specifically contains proximal-distal patterning and distal tubule, loop of Henle and collecting duct development.

qualifier: methylmalonyl-CoA mutase pathway and methylmalonic aciduria
name: Cobalamin metabolism and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase deficiency
rationale: Members are cobalamin metabolism and its disorders affecting the adenosylcobalamin-dependent methylmalonyl-CoA mutase step of propionyl-CoA catabolism (MUT, MMAA, MMAB, CD320); confusables cover cobalamin absorption/transport, combined MMA-homocystinuria (MMACHC/MMADHC) or branched-chain organic acidurias.

core: Hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell regulation
qualifier: early myeloid and erythroid progenitor fate
name: Hematopoietic stem and myeloid-erythroid progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members concern HSC homeostasis, proliferation and division and early myeloid/erythroid progenitor differentiation (RUNX1, promyelocyte programme, primitive/definitive erythropoiesis); confusables emphasise stem cell maintenance, bone marrow/B cell development, or late erythroid and megakaryocyte maturation.

qualifier: DUB protease families and linkage-specific chain editing
name: Ubiquitin chain editing by deubiquitinase families
rationale: Members are DUB families (USP, OTU, JAMM metalloproteases) and K11/K48/K63 linkage-specific deubiquitination, plus ubiquitin activation, i.e. ubiquitin chain editing; confusables cover neddylation, NF-kappaB regulation, PKR signaling or atypical chain ubiquitination.

name: Axon extension and regeneration under semaphorin and netrin repulsion
rationale: Members concern axon growth, collateral sprouting, PNS regeneration and guidance via Sema3A-plexin/CRMP and netrin repulsion with RHOA/ceramide growth inhibition; confusables are dominated by ephrin, SLIT-ROBO, L1/DSCAM adhesion and fasciculation instead.

name: Nucleolar chromatin silencing of RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription
rationale: All three members concern negative regulation of Pol I rRNA transcription through nucleolar chromatin (SIRT1); confusables cover Pol I initiation, elongation/termination or rRNA processing rather than repression.

core: Th2 differentiation and type 2 cytokine production
qualifier: IgE switching and mast cell activation
name: Th2 differentiation, type 2 cytokine production and IgE switching
rationale: Members regulate Th2 differentiation, IL-4/IL-5/IL-13 production, IgE isotype switching and mast cell cytokine output; confusables centre on eosinophil biology, IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 receptor signaling or Fc-epsilon receptor mast cell degranulation.

name: Platelet activation with inhibition of fibrinolysis
rationale: Members combine platelet activation/degranulation with negative regulation of plasminogen activation and fibrinolysis (clot stabilisation); confusables cover platelet activation, coagulation cascade or matrix adhesion without the antifibrinolytic arm.

name: Cell cycle DNA replication initiation and its negative regulation
rationale: All members concern initiation and restraint of mitotic DNA replication (including an E2F1 target module); confusables cover broad E2F/G1-S transcription, pre-RC assembly with replication stress, or intra-S damage checkpoints.

name: Heme-derived bilirubin clearance and inherited hyperbilirubinemias
rationale: Members span heme degradation, hepatic SLCO uptake, UGT1A glucuronidation and ABCC2 export of bilirubin plus their hyperbilirubinemia defects; confusables are drug/xenobiotic ADME and transport.

qualifier: mRNA, tRNA and ribosomal subunit cargo
name: Nuclear export of mRNA, tRNA and ribosomal subunits
rationale: Members concern transport of mature mRNAs, tRNA and pre-ribosomal subunits through the nuclear pore (with related RNA trafficking); C1 covers nuclear pore assembly and other cargo, while C2-C4 add mRNA 3'-end processing rather than tRNA/ribosome export.

name: NOTCH1/2 activation and oncogenic constitutive NOTCH1 signaling
rationale: Members are NOTCH1/NOTCH2 activation and nuclear signaling plus constitutive NOTCH1 HD/PEST/translocation mutants and FBXW7 loss; confusables emphasise NOTCH3/NOTCH4, receptor processing or Notch-HLH target transcription.

name: Mammary, prostate and reproductive tract epithelial development
rationale: Members concern branching, differentiation and growth of mammary and prostate glandular epithelium and development of uterus, oviduct, vagina and genitalia; confusables cover lung/salivary branching, gonad/sex determination or kidney development.

name: Congenital glycosylation disorders of ALG dolichol-oligosaccharide assembly
rationale: All six members are CDG type I from defective ALG glycosyltransferases building the dolichol-linked oligosaccharide; confusables are CDGs of dolichol/mannose donor synthesis (DOLK, DPM, PMM2, MPI) or Golgi processing.

name: Growth plate chondrocyte proliferation and hypertrophic maturation
rationale: Members regulate chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and RUNX2-driven hypertrophy in the growth plate; confusables cover osteoblast/ossification or early chondrogenic condensation.

name: Olfactory receptor-mediated smell and pheromone perception
rationale: All members concern odorant/pheromone detection by olfactory receptors and smell perception; confusables are taste perception modalities.

name: Eicosanoid synthesis by P450 oxygenases and 12-lipoxygenase-hepoxilin route
rationale: Members concern oxygenation of arachidonic/linoleic acid to HETEs, EETs, 12-HETE derivatives and hepoxilins (including skin-barrier CYP4F22/SLC27A4 defects); C1/C4 lack the P450 epoxygenase/hydroxylase branch and C2/C3 are leukotriene-focused without 12-LOX/hepoxilins.

core: Homologous recombination repair of double-strand breaks
name: Homologous recombination repair and BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 defects
rationale: Members cover end resection, RAD51 strand exchange, D-loop resolution and SSA together with BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 loss-of-function HRR defects; confusables emphasise DSB sensing, NHEJ/MMEJ or replication fork resection.

qualifier: renal NaPi-II cotransport and FGFR1c-Klotho signaling
name: Renal phosphate reabsorption via NaPi-II and FGFR1c-Klotho signaling
rationale: Members concern sodium-phosphate cotransport (SLC34A1/A3 and their hypophosphatemic disorders), PTH response and FGFR1c-Klotho signaling controlling phosphate and mineralization; confusables lack the FGFR-Klotho arm (C1) or the NaPi-II transporters (vitamin D, dentin, mineralization).

name: Mammary ductal branching, alveolar development and lactation
rationale: All members concern mammary epithelial proliferation, ductal branching, alveolar development and lactation; confusables add luminal/myoepithelial/stem lineages or involution instead.

name: Methionine-SAM-homocysteine cycle and its inherited enzyme defects
rationale: Members are methionine/SAM metabolism and defects of MAT1A, AHCY, MTR and MTRR in the methionine cycle; confusables cover folate one-carbon metabolism, choline/carnitine/creatine, or methionine salvage and selenium metabolism.

name: NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome IL-1 processing and inflammatory chemokine production
rationale: Members combine NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasomes, IL-1 precursor processing and purinergic activation with CXCL1/CXCL2/CCL3/CCL5 production; confusables cover TLR/LPS signaling, pyroptosis via other inflammasomes, DC chemokines or IL-17/IL-18 signaling.

core: Renin-angiotensin blood pressure and volume regulation
qualifier: vasoactive peptide processing and renal natriuresis
name: Renin-angiotensin and vasoactive peptide control of blood volume and natriuresis
rationale: Members concern angiotensin generation and signaling, bradykinin/neuropeptide catabolism and natriuretic cGMP signaling in renal sodium, urine volume and blood pressure control; confusables focus on nitric oxide/eNOS, smooth muscle contraction or neural/endothelin pressure regulation.
